name: s05-trycycle
title: How try, except, else and finally run
spec: A flowchart: box try body, then a diamond Exception raised? Yes goes to matching except block. No goes to else block. Both paths and the unhandled path join a box finally that always runs. After finally an arrow to continue. An orange note on finally: runs on success, on handled errors and on unhandled errors.
cap: Exception mechanics: finally runs whether the body succeeds, is handled, or fails unhandled.

name: s05-logging
title: Logger to handler to formatter
spec: Left: a column of five level chips from low to high: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL, with a threshold line labelled records below the level are dropped. Right: a flow logger -> handler -> formatter -> destination (file, stream). Orange note: set the level once at start-up.
cap: Logging: a logger drops records below its level, then a handler and a formatter send the rest to a destination.

name: s05-atomic
title: Atomic file replace
spec: A left-to-right flow of four boxes: write to a temp file in the same directory ; flush and fsync ; os.replace(temp, target) ; readers see old file or new file, never half a file (green). A grey crossed-out box below: writing the target directly can leave a half-written file.
cap: Safe writes: write a temp file, then replace the target in one step so readers never see half a file.

name: s05-subproc
title: Safe subprocess defaults
spec: Left code chip box: subprocess.run(["ls", "-l"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30, check=True). Five green labelled pointers to its parts: argument list not a string ; capture_output gets stdout and stderr ; text=True decodes to str ; timeout stops hangs ; check=True raises on failure. An orange note: shell=True with user input invites injection.
cap: Safe subprocess defaults: pass an argument list, set a timeout, and raise on a non-zero exit.

name: s05-signals
title: Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM
spec: A left-to-right flow of five steps: 1 SIGTERM arrives ; 2 handler sets a stop flag ; 3 the loop finishes the current item ; 4 cleanup closes files and connections ; 5 exit with status 0 (green). Under it, an orange note: the handler should only set a flag, not do the work.
alt: Graceful shutdown with a signal handler
cap: Graceful shutdown: the signal handler sets a flag, the loop finishes its item, then cleanup runs.
